clangoroussoul.fullDesc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage in exchange for the user losing 33% of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stat stages would not change.

clangoroussoulblaze.name: Clangorous Soulblaze
clangoroussoulblaze.fullDesc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

clearsmog.name: Clear Smog
clearsmog.shortDesc: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.
clearsmog.fullDesc: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.

closecombat.name: Close Combat
closecombat.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
closecombat.fullDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

coaching.name: Coaching
coaching.shortDesc: Raises an ally's Attack and Defense by 1.
coaching.fullDesc: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

coil.name: Coil
coil.shortDesc: Raises user's Attack, Defense, accuracy by 1.
coil.fullDesc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and accuracy by 1 stage.

collisioncourse.name: Collision Course
collisioncourse.fullDesc: Damage is multiplied by 1.3333 if this move is super effective against the target.

combattorque.name: Combat Torque
combattorque.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

cometpunch.name: Comet Punch
cometpunch.fullDesc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

comeuppance.name: Comeuppance
comeuppance.shortDesc: If hit by an attack, returns 1.5× damage.
comeuppance.fullDesc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.

confide.name: Confide
confide.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 1.
confide.fullDesc: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

confuseray.name: Confuse Ray
confuseray.fullDesc: Causes the target to become confused.

confusion.name: Confusion
confusion.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.

constrict.name: Constrict
constrict.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
constrict.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

continentalcrush.name: Continental Crush
continentalcrush.shortDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.
continentalcrush.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

conversion.name: Conversion
conversion.shortDesc: Changes user's type to match its first move.
conversion.fullDesc: The user's type changes to match the original type of the move in its first move slot. Fails if the user cannot change its type, or if the type is one of the user's current types.

conversion2.name: Conversion 2
conversion2.shortDesc: Changes user's type to resist target's last move.
conversion2.fullDesc: The user's type changes to match a type that resists or is immune to the type of the last move used by the target, but not either of its current types. The determined type of the move is used rather than the original type. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user cannot change its type, or if this move would only be able to select one of the user's current types.

copycat.name: Copycat
copycat.shortDesc: Uses the last move used in the battle.
copycat.fullDesc: The user uses the last move used by any Pokemon, including itself. Fails if no move has been used, or if the last move used was Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dragon Tail, Dynamax Cannon, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.

coreenforcer.name: Core Enforcer
coreenforcer.shortDesc: Nullifies the foe(s) Ability if the foe(s) move first.
coreenforcer.fullDesc: If the user moves after the target, the target's Ability is rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this effect does not happen, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.

corkscrewcrash.name: Corkscrew Crash
corkscrewcrash.shortDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.
corkscrewcrash.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

corrosivegas.name: Corrosive Gas
corrosivegas.fullDesc: The target loses its held item. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item or cause a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

cosmicpower.name: Cosmic Power
cosmicpower.shortDesc: Raises the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
cosmicpower.fullDesc: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

cottonguard.name: Cotton Guard
cottonguard.fullDesc: Raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.

cottonspore.name: Cotton Spore
cottonspore.fullDesc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

counter.name: Counter
counter.shortDesc: If hit by physical attack, returns double damage.
counter.fullDesc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical attack this turn.

courtchange.name: Court Change
courtchange.shortDesc: Swaps user's field effects with the opposing side.
courtchange.fullDesc: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.

covet.name: Covet
covet.shortDesc: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.
covet.fullDesc: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

crabhammer.name: Crabhammer
crabhammer.fullDesc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

craftyshield.name: Crafty Shield
craftyshield.shortDesc: Protects allies from Status moves this turn.
craftyshield.fullDesc: The user and its party members are protected from non-damaging attacks made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

crosschop.name: Cross Chop
crosschop.fullDesc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

crosspoison.name: Cross Poison
crosspoison.shortDesc: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to poison.
crosspoison.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.shortDesc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
crunch.fullDesc: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

crushclaw.name: Crush Claw
crushclaw.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
crushclaw.fullDesc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

crushgrip.name: Crush Grip
crushgrip.shortDesc: More power the more HP the target has left.
crushgrip.fullDesc: Power is equal to 120 × (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.

curse.name: Curse
curse.shortDesc: Curses if Ghost, else -1 Spe, +1 Atk, +1 Def.
curse.fullDesc: If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected.

darkestlariat.name: Darkest Lariat
darkestlariat.shortDesc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes.
darkestlariat.fullDesc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

darkpulse.name: Dark Pulse
darkpulse.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.
darkpulse.fullDesc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

darkvoid.name: Dark Void
darkvoid.shortDesc: Darkrai: Causes the foe(s) to fall asleep.
darkvoid.fullDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Darkrai.

dazzlinggleam.name: Dazzling Gleam
dazzlinggleam.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

decorate.name: Decorate
decorate.shortDesc: Raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 2.
decorate.fullDesc: Raises the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.

defendorder.name: Defend Order
defendorder.shortDesc: Raises the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
defendorder.fullDesc: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

defensecurl.name: Defense Curl
defensecurl.fullDesc: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage. As long as the user remains active, the power of the user's Ice Ball and Rollout will be doubled (this effect is not stackable).

defog.name: Defog
defog.shortDesc: -1 evasion; ends user and target hazards/terrain.
defog.fullDesc: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage. If this move is successful and whether or not the target's evasiveness was affected, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side. Ignores a target's substitute, although a substitute will still block the lowering of evasiveness. If there is a terrain active and this move is successful, the terrain will be cleared.

destinybond.name: Destiny Bond
destinybond.shortDesc: If an opponent knocks out the user, it also faints.
destinybond.fullDesc: Until the user's next move, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that Pokemon faints as well, unless the attack was Doom Desire or Future Sight. Fails if the user used this move successfully as its last move, disregarding moves used through the Dancer Ability.

detect.name: Detect
detect.shortDesc: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.
detect.fullDesc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

devastatingdrake.name: Devastating Drake
devastatingdrake.shortDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.
devastatingdrake.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

diamondstorm.name: Diamond Storm
diamondstorm.shortDesc: 50% chance to raise user's Defense by 2.
diamondstorm.fullDesc: Has a 50% chance to raise the user's Defense by 2 stages.

dig.name: Dig
dig.fullDesc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Earthquake and Magnitude but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

direclaw.name: Dire Claw
direclaw.shortDesc: 30% chance to poison, paralyze, or put the target to sleep.
direclaw.fullDesc: 30% chance to inflict poison, paralysis, or sleep, chosen at random (10% each).

disable.name: Disable
disable.shortDesc: For 4 turns, disables the target's last move used.
disable.fullDesc: For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Max or G-Max Move.

disarmingvoice.name: Disarming Voice
disarmingvoice.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy. Hits foes.
disarmingvoice.fullDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

discharge.name: Discharge
discharge.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

dive.name: Dive
dive.fullDesc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Surf and Whirlpool but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

dizzypunch.name: Dizzy Punch
dizzypunch.fullDesc: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

doodle.name: Doodle
doodle.shortDesc: User and ally's Abilities become target's Ability.
doodle.fullDesc: The user and its ally's Abilities change to match the target's Ability. Does not change Ability if the user's or its ally's is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target. Fails if both the user and its ally's Ability already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

doomdesire.name: Doom Desire
doomdesire.shortDesc: Hits two turns after being used.
doomdesire.fullDesc: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Future Sight is already in effect for the target's position.

doubleedge.name: Double-Edge
doubleedge.fullDesc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

doublehit.name: Double Hit
doublehit.fullDesc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

doubleironbash.name: Double Iron Bash
doubleironbash.shortDesc: Hits twice. 30% chance to make the target flinch.
doubleironbash.fullDesc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

doublekick.name: Double Kick
doublekick.fullDesc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

doubleshock.name: Double Shock
doubleshock.shortDesc: User's Electric type: typeless; must be Electric.
doubleshock.fullDesc: Fails unless the user is an Electric type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Electric type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.

doubleslap.name: Double Slap
doubleslap.fullDesc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

doubleteam.name: Double Team
doubleteam.fullDesc: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1 stage.

dracometeor.name: Draco Meteor
dracometeor.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.
dracometeor.fullDesc: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

dragonascent.name: Dragon Ascent
dragonascent.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
dragonascent.fullDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

dragonbreath.name: Dragon Breath
dragonbreath.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

dragoncheer.name: Dragon Cheer
dragoncheer.shortDesc: Ally: Crit ratio +1, or +2 if ally is Dragon type.
dragoncheer.fullDesc: Raises the target's chance for a critical hit by 1 stage, or by 2 stages if the target is Dragon type. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user, or if the target already has this effect or the Focus Energy effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

dragondance.name: Dragon Dance
dragondance.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1.
dragondance.fullDesc: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage.

dragondarts.name: Dragon Darts
dragondarts.shortDesc: Hits twice. Doubles: Tries to hit each foe once.
dragondarts.fullDesc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. In Double Battles, this move attempts to hit the targeted Pokemon and its ally once each. If hitting one of these Pokemon would be prevented by immunity, protection, semi-invulnerability, an Ability, or accuracy, it attempts to hit the other Pokemon twice instead. If this move is redirected, it hits that target twice.

dragonenergy.name: Dragon Energy
dragonenergy.shortDesc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).
dragonenergy.fullDesc: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

dragonrage.name: Dragon Rage
dragonrage.shortDesc: Deals 40 HP of damage to the target.
dragonrage.fullDesc: Deals 40 HP of damage to the target.

dragonrush.name: Dragon Rush
dragonrush.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.
dragonrush.fullDesc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

dragontail.name: Dragon Tail
dragontail.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
dragontail.fullDesc: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.

drainingkiss.name: Draining Kiss
drainingkiss.shortDesc: User recovers 75% of the damage dealt.
drainingkiss.fullDesc: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

drainpunch.name: Drain Punch
drainpunch.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
drainpunch.fullDesc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

dreameater.name: Dream Eater
dreameater.shortDesc: User gains 1/2 HP inflicted. Sleeping target only.
dreameater.fullDesc: The target is unaffected by this move unless it is asleep. The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

drillrun.name: Drill Run
drillrun.fullDesc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

drumbeating.name: Drum Beating
drumbeating.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
drumbeating.fullDesc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

dualchop.name: Dual Chop
dualchop.fullDesc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

dualwingbeat.name: Dual Wingbeat
dualwingbeat.fullDesc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

dynamicpunch.name: Dynamic Punch
dynamicpunch.fullDesc: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.

earthpower.name: Earth Power
earthpower.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
earthpower.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dig.
earthquake.fullDesc: Damage doubles if the target is using Dig.

echoedvoice.name: Echoed Voice
echoedvoice.shortDesc: Power increases when used on consecutive turns.
echoedvoice.fullDesc: For every consecutive turn that this move is used by at least one Pokemon, this move's power is multiplied by the number of turns to pass, but not more than 5.

eerieimpulse.name: Eerie Impulse
eerieimpulse.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 2.
eerieimpulse.fullDesc: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.

eeriespell.name: Eerie Spell
eeriespell.shortDesc: Removes 3 PP from the target's last move.
eeriespell.fullDesc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the target loses 3 PP from its last move.

electricterrain.name: Electric Terrain
electricterrain.fullDesc: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Electric Terrain. During the effect, the power of Electric-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot fall asleep; Pokemon already asleep do not wake up. Grounded Pokemon cannot become affected by Yawn or fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into an Electric type, Nature Power becomes Thunderbolt, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause paralysis. Fails if the current terrain is Electric Terrain.

electrify.name: Electrify
electrify.shortDesc: Changes the target's move to Electric this turn.
electrify.fullDesc: Causes the target's move to become Electric type this turn. Among effects that can change a move's type, this effect happens last. Fails if the target already moved this turn.

electroball.name: Electro Ball
electroball.shortDesc: More power the faster the user is than the target.
electroball.fullDesc: The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 150 if the result is 4 or more, 120 if 3, 80 if 2, 60 if 1, 40 if less than 1. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 40.

electrodrift.name: Electro Drift
electrodrift.fullDesc: Damage is multiplied by 1.3333 if this move is super effective against the target.

electroshot.name: Electro Shot
electroshot.shortDesc: Raises Sp. Atk by 1, hits turn 2. Rain: no charge.
electroshot.fullDesc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, the move still requires a turn to charge.

electroweb.name: Electroweb
electroweb.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.
electroweb.fullDesc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

embargo.name: Embargo
embargo.shortDesc: For 5 turns, the target's item has no effect.
embargo.fullDesc: For 5 turns, the target's held item has no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by the target. Items thrown at the target with Fling will still activate for it. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to use items.

ember.name: Ember
ember.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

encore.name: Encore
encore.shortDesc: Target repeats its last move for its next 3 turns.
encore.fullDesc: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.

endeavor.name: Endeavor
endeavor.shortDesc: Lowers the target's HP to the user's HP.
endeavor.fullDesc: Deals damage to the target equal to (target's current HP - user's current HP). The target is unaffected if its current HP is less than or equal to the user's current HP.

endure.name: Endure
endure.shortDesc: User survives attacks this turn with at least 1 HP.
endure.fullDesc: The user will survive attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn with at least 1 HP. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

energyball.name: Energy Ball
energyball.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
energyball.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

entrainment.name: Entrainment
entrainment.shortDesc: The target's Ability changes to match the user's.
entrainment.fullDesc: Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.shortDesc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).
eruption.fullDesc: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

esperwing.name: Esper Wing
esperwing.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise user Speed by 1. High crit.
esperwing.fullDesc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage and a higher chance for a critical hit.

eternabeam.name: Eternabeam
eternabeam.fullDesc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

expandingforce.name: Expanding Force
expandingforce.shortDesc: User on Psychic Terrain: 1.5× power, hits foes.
expandingforce.fullDesc: If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. The user faints.
explosion.fullDesc: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
extrasensory.shortDesc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.
extrasensory.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

extremeevoboost.name: Extreme Evoboost
extremeevoboost.shortDesc: Raises user's Atk, Def, SpA, SpD, and Spe by 2.
extremeevoboost.fullDesc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 2 stages.

facade.name: Facade
facade.shortDesc: Power doubles if user is burn/poison/paralyzed.
facade.fullDesc: Power doubles if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned. The physical damage halving effect from the user's burn is ignored.

fairylock.name: Fairy Lock
fairylock.shortDesc: Prevents all Pokemon from switching next turn.
fairylock.fullDesc: Prevents all active Pokemon from switching next turn. A Pokemon can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the effect is already active.

fakeout.name: Fake Out
fakeout.shortDesc: Hits first. First turn out only. 100% flinch chance.
fakeout.fullDesc: Can only be used on the first turn after the user enters battle. +3 priority and causes flinching if the target can flinch.

faketears.name: Fake Tears
faketears.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Sp. Def by 2.
faketears.fullDesc: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

falsesurrender.name: False Surrender
falsesurrender.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.
falsesurrender.fullDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

falseswipe.name: False Swipe
falseswipe.shortDesc: Always leaves the target with at least 1 HP.
falseswipe.fullDesc: Leaves the target with at least 1 HP.

featherdance.name: Feather Dance
featherdance.fullDesc: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.

feint.name: Feint
feint.shortDesc: Nullifies Detect, Protect, and Quick/Wide Guard.
feint.fullDesc: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.

feintattack.name: Feint Attack
feintattack.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.
feintattack.fullDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

fellstinger.name: Fell Stinger
fellstinger.shortDesc: Raises user's Attack by 3 if this KOes the target.
fellstinger.fullDesc: Raises the user's Attack by 3 stages if this move knocks out the target.

ficklebeam.name: Fickle Beam
ficklebeam.shortDesc: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.
ficklebeam.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.

fierydance.name: Fiery Dance
fierydance.shortDesc: 50% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.
fierydance.fullDesc: Has a 50% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

fierywrath.name: Fiery Wrath
fierywrath.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.
fierywrath.fullDesc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

filletaway.name: Fillet Away
filletaway.shortDesc: +2 Attack, Sp. Atk, Speed for 1/2 user's max HP.
filletaway.fullDesc: Raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 2 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed stat stages would not change.

finalgambit.name: Final Gambit
finalgambit.shortDesc: Does damage equal to the user's HP. User faints.
finalgambit.fullDesc: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's current HP. If this move is successful, the user faints.

fireblast.name: Fire Blast
fireblast.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

firefang.name: Fire Fang
firefang.shortDesc: 10% chance to burn. 10% chance to flinch.
firefang.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.

firelash.name: Fire Lash
firelash.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
firelash.fullDesc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

firepledge.name: Fire Pledge
firepledge.shortDesc: Use with Grass or Water Pledge for added effect.
firepledge.fullDesc: If one of the user's allies chose to use Grass Pledge or Water Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Fire Pledge with 150 power and a sea of fire appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which causes damage to non-Fire types equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn. If combined with Water Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Fire Gem.

firepunch.name: Fire Punch
firepunch.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

firespin.name: Fire Spin
firespin.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
firespin.fullDesc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

firstimpression.name: First Impression
firstimpression.shortDesc: Nearly always goes first. First turn out only.
firstimpression.fullDesc: Can only be used on the first turn after the user enters battle. +2 priority; fails on later turns.

fishiousrend.name: Fishious Rend
fishiousrend.shortDesc: Power doubles if user moves before the target.
fishiousrend.fullDesc: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

fissure.name: Fissure
fissure.shortDesc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.
fissure.fullDesc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

flail.name: Flail
flail.shortDesc: More power the less HP the user has left.
flail.fullDesc: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP × 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.

flameburst.name: Flame Burst
flameburst.shortDesc: Damages Pokemon next to the target as well.
flameburst.fullDesc: If this move is successful, the target's ally loses 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, unless it has the Magic Guard Ability.

flamecharge.name: Flame Charge
flamecharge.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.
flamecharge.fullDesc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

flamewheel.name: Flame Wheel
flamewheel.shortDesc: 10% chance to burn the target. Thaws user.
flamewheel.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

flareblitz.name: Flare Blitz
flareblitz.shortDesc: Has 33% recoil. 10% chance to burn. Thaws user.
flareblitz.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

flash.name: Flash
flash.fullDesc: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

flashcannon.name: Flash Cannon
flashcannon.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
flashcannon.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

flatter.name: Flatter
flatter.shortDesc: Raises the target's Sp. Atk by 1 and confuses it.
flatter.fullDesc: Raises the target's Special Attack by 1 stage and confuses it.

fleurcannon.name: Fleur Cannon
fleurcannon.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.
fleurcannon.fullDesc: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

fling.name: Fling
fling.shortDesc: Flings the user's item at the target. Power varies.
fling.fullDesc: The power of this move is based on the user's held item. The held item is lost and it activates for the target if applicable. If there is no target or the target avoids this move by protecting itself, the user's held item is still lost. The user can regain a thrown item with Recycle or the Harvest Ability. Fails if the user has no held item, if the held item cannot be thrown, if the user is under the effect of Embargo or Magic Room, or if the user has the Klutz Ability.

flipturn.name: Flip Turn
flipturn.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.
flipturn.fullDesc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

floatyfall.name: Floaty Fall
floatyfall.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
floatyfall.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

floralhealing.name: Floral Healing
floralhealing.shortDesc: Heals the target by 50% of its max HP.
floralhealing.fullDesc: The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the terrain is Grassy Terrain, the target instead restores 2/3 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.

flowershield.name: Flower Shield
flowershield.shortDesc: Raises Defense by 1 of all active Grass types.
flowershield.fullDesc: Raises the Defense of all active Grass-type Pokemon by 1 stage. Fails if there are no active Grass-type Pokemon.

flowertrick.name: Flower Trick
flowertrick.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit; no accuracy check.
flowertrick.fullDesc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities. This move does not check accuracy.

fly.name: Fly
fly.shortDesc: Flies up on first turn, then strikes the next turn.
fly.fullDesc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

flyingpress.name: Flying Press
flyingpress.shortDesc: Combines Flying in its type effectiveness.
flyingpress.fullDesc: This move combines Flying in its type effectiveness against the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

focusblast.name: Focus Blast
focusblast.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
focusblast.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

focusenergy.name: Focus Energy
focusenergy.shortDesc: Raises the user's critical hit ratio by 2.
focusenergy.fullDesc: Raises the user's chance for a critical hit by 2 stages. Fails if the user already has the effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

focuspunch.name: Focus Punch
focuspunch.shortDesc: Fails if the user takes damage before it hits.
focuspunch.fullDesc: The user loses its focus and does nothing if it is hit by a damaging attack this turn before it can execute the move.

followme.name: Follow Me
followme.shortDesc: The foes' moves target the user on the turn used.
followme.fullDesc: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

forcepalm.name: Force Palm
forcepalm.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.shortDesc: Fighting, Normal hit Ghost. Evasiveness ignored.
foresight.fullDesc: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it if it is greater than 0, and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Ghost type. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Miracle Eye or Odor Sleuth.

forestscurse.name: Forest's Curse
forestscurse.shortDesc: Adds Grass to the target's type(s).
forestscurse.fullDesc: Causes the Grass type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Grass type. If Trick-or-Treat adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.

foulplay.name: Foul Play
foulplay.shortDesc: Uses target's Attack stat in damage calculation.
foulplay.fullDesc: Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.

freezedry.name: Freeze-Dry
freezedry.shortDesc: Super effective against Water; no freeze chance.
freezedry.fullDesc: Super effective against Water-type Pokémon. Has no additional freeze chance in Champions.

freezeshock.name: Freeze Shock
freezeshock.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

freezingglare.name: Freezing Glare
freezingglare.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

freezyfrost.name: Freezy Frost
freezyfrost.fullDesc: Resets the stat stages of all active Pokemon to 0.

frenzyplant.name: Frenzy Plant
frenzyplant.fullDesc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

frostbreath.name: Frost Breath
frostbreath.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit.
frostbreath.fullDesc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

frustration.name: Frustration
frustration.fullDesc: Power is equal to the greater of ((255 - user's Happiness) × 2/5), rounded down, or 1.

furyattack.name: Fury Attack
furyattack.fullDesc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

furycutter.name: Fury Cutter
furycutter.shortDesc: Power doubles with each hit, up to 160.
furycutter.fullDesc: Power doubles with each successful hit, up to a maximum of 160 power. The power is reset if this move misses or another move is used.

furyswipes.name: Fury Swipes
furyswipes.fullDesc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

fusionbolt.name: Fusion Bolt
fusionbolt.shortDesc: Power doubles if used after Fusion Flare this turn.
fusionbolt.fullDesc: Power doubles if the last move used by any Pokemon this turn was Fusion Flare.

fusionflare.name: Fusion Flare
fusionflare.shortDesc: Power doubles if used after Fusion Bolt this turn.
fusionflare.fullDesc: Power doubles if the last move used by any Pokemon this turn was Fusion Bolt.

futuresight.name: Future Sight
futuresight.shortDesc: Hits two turns after being used.
futuresight.fullDesc: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Doom Desire is already in effect for the target's position.

gastroacid.name: Gastro Acid
gastroacid.fullDesc: Causes the target's Ability to be rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this move fails, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.

geargrind.name: Gear Grind
geargrind.fullDesc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

gearup.name: Gear Up
gearup.shortDesc: Raises Atk, Sp. Atk of allies with Plus/Minus by 1.
gearup.fullDesc: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of Pokemon on the user's side with the Plus or Minus Abilities by 1 stage.

genesissupernova.name: Genesis Supernova
genesissupernova.fullDesc: If this move is successful, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain.

geomancy.name: Geomancy
geomancy.shortDesc: Charges, then raises SpA, SpD, Spe by 2 turn 2.
geomancy.fullDesc: Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 2 stages. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

gigadrain.name: Giga Drain
gigadrain.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
gigadrain.fullDesc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

gigaimpact.name: Giga Impact
gigaimpact.fullDesc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

gigatonhammer.name: Gigaton Hammer
gigatonhammer.shortDesc: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.
gigatonhammer.fullDesc: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.

gigavolthavoc.name: Gigavolt Havoc
gigavolthavoc.shortDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.
gigavolthavoc.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

glaciallance.name: Glacial Lance
glaciallance.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

glaciate.name: Glaciate
glaciate.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.
glaciate.fullDesc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

glaiverush.name: Glaive Rush
glaiverush.shortDesc: User takes sure-hit 2× damage until its next turn.
glaiverush.fullDesc: If this move is successful, moves targeted at the user deal double damage and do not check accuracy until the user's next turn.

glitzyglow.name: Glitzy Glow
glitzyglow.fullDesc: This move summons Light Screen for 5 turns upon use.

gmaxbefuddle.name: G-Max Befuddle
gmaxbefuddle.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: slp or psn or par.
gmaxbefuddle.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side either falls asleep, becomes poisoned, or becomes paralyzed, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxcannonade.name: G-Max Cannonade
gmaxcannonade.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1/6 HP, 4 turns.
gmaxcannonade.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, for 4 turns each non-Water-type Pokemon on the opposing side takes damage equal to 1/6 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn.

gmaxcentiferno.name: G-Max Centiferno
gmaxcentiferno.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: bound 4-5 turns.
gmaxcentiferno.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side is prevented from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw), even if they have a substitute. Causes damage equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. They can still switch out if they are holding Shed Shell or use Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends for a target if it leaves the field, or if it uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

gmaxchistrike.name: G-Max Chi Strike
gmaxchistrike.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Allies: Crit Ratio +1.
gmaxchistrike.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the user's side has their critical hit ratio raised by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxcuddle.name: G-Max Cuddle
gmaxcuddle.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: infatuated.
gmaxcuddle.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side becomes infatuated, even if they have a substitute. This effect does not happen for a target if both it and the user are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated.

gmaxdepletion.name: G-Max Depletion
gmaxdepletion.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: last move -2 PP.
gmaxdepletion.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side loses 2 PP from its last move used, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxdrumsolo.name: G-Max Drum Solo
gmaxdrumsolo.fullDesc: Power is 160 regardless of the base move's Max Move power. This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

gmaxfinale.name: G-Max Finale
gmaxfinale.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Allies: +1/6 max HP.
gmaxfinale.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/6 of its current maximum HP, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxfireball.name: G-Max Fire Ball
gmaxfireball.fullDesc: Power is 160 regardless of the base move's Max Move power. This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

gmaxfoamburst.name: G-Max Foam Burst
gmaxfoamburst.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -2 Speed.
gmaxfoamburst.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the Speed of each Pokemon on the opposing side is lowered by 2 stages, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxgoldrush.name: G-Max Gold Rush
gmaxgoldrush.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: confused.
gmaxgoldrush.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side becomes confused, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxgravitas.name: G-Max Gravitas
gmaxgravitas.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Starts Gravity.
gmaxgravitas.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Gravity begins.

gmaxhydrosnipe.name: G-Max Hydrosnipe
gmaxhydrosnipe.fullDesc: Power is 160 regardless of the base move's Max Move power. This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

gmaxmalodor.name: G-Max Malodor
gmaxmalodor.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: poisoned.
gmaxmalodor.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side becomes poisoned, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxmeltdown.name: G-Max Meltdown
gmaxmeltdown.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: Tormented.
gmaxmeltdown.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Torment begins for each Pokemon on the opposing side, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxoneblow.name: G-Max One Blow
gmaxoneblow.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Bypasses Max Guard.
gmaxoneblow.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. This move bypasses all protection effects, including Max Guard.

gmaxrapidflow.name: G-Max Rapid Flow
gmaxrapidflow.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Bypasses Max Guard.
gmaxrapidflow.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. This move bypasses all protection effects, including Max Guard.

gmaxreplenish.name: G-Max Replenish
gmaxreplenish.shortDesc: Base move affects power. 50% restores Berries.
gmaxreplenish.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, there is a 50% chance every Pokemon on the user's side has its Berry restored, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxresonance.name: G-Max Resonance
gmaxresonance.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Allies: Aurora Veil.
gmaxresonance.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effect of Aurora Veil begins on the user's side.

gmaxsandblast.name: G-Max Sandblast
gmaxsandblast.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: bound 4-5 turns.
gmaxsandblast.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side is prevented from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw), even if they have a substitute. Causes damage equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. They can still switch out if they are holding Shed Shell or use Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends for a target if it leaves the field, or if it uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

gmaxsmite.name: G-Max Smite
gmaxsmite.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: confused.
gmaxsmite.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side becomes confused, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxsnooze.name: G-Max Snooze
gmaxsnooze.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Target: 50% Yawn.
gmaxsnooze.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, there is a 50% chance the effect of Yawn begins on the target, even if it has a substitute.

gmaxsteelsurge.name: G-Max Steelsurge
gmaxsteelsurge.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: Steel hazard.
gmaxsteelsurge.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Steel type; 0.25×, 0.5×, neutral, 2×, or 4×, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

gmaxstonesurge.name: G-Max Stonesurge
gmaxstonesurge.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: Stealth Rock.
gmaxstonesurge.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25×, 0.5×, neutral, 2×, or 4×, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

gmaxstunshock.name: G-Max Stun Shock
gmaxstunshock.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: psn or par.
gmaxstunshock.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side either becomes poisoned or paralyzed, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxsweetness.name: G-Max Sweetness
gmaxsweetness.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Allies: status cured.
gmaxsweetness.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the user's side has its status condition cured, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxtartness.name: G-Max Tartness
gmaxtartness.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1 evasiveness.
gmaxtartness.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the evasiveness of each Pokemon on the opposing side is lowered by 1 stage, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxterror.name: G-Max Terror
gmaxterror.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: trapped.
gmaxterror.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side is prevented from switching out, even if they have a substitute. They can still switch out if they are holding Shed Shell or use Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

gmaxvinelash.name: G-Max Vine Lash
gmaxvinelash.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1/6 HP, 4 turns.
gmaxvinelash.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, for 4 turns each non-Grass-type Pokemon on the opposing side takes damage equal to 1/6 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn.

gmaxvolcalith.name: G-Max Volcalith
gmaxvolcalith.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1/6 HP, 4 turns.
gmaxvolcalith.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, for 4 turns each non-Rock-type Pokemon on the opposing side takes damage equal to 1/6 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn.

gmaxvoltcrash.name: G-Max Volt Crash
gmaxvoltcrash.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: paralyzed.
gmaxvoltcrash.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, each Pokemon on the opposing side becomes paralyzed, even if they have a substitute.

gmaxwildfire.name: G-Max Wildfire
gmaxwildfire.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Foes: -1/6 HP, 4 turns.
gmaxwildfire.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, for 4 turns each non-Fire-type Pokemon on the opposing side takes damage equal to 1/6 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn.

gmaxwindrage.name: G-Max Wind Rage
gmaxwindrage.shortDesc: Base move affects power. Ends Terrain, hazards.
gmaxwindrage.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Max Move power. If this move is successful, the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain end, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, G-Max Steelsurge, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of G-Max Steelsurge, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side.

grassknot.name: Grass Knot
grassknot.shortDesc: More power the heavier the target.
grassknot.fullDesc: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.

grasspledge.name: Grass Pledge
grasspledge.shortDesc: Use with Fire or Water Pledge for added effect.
grasspledge.fullDesc: If one of the user's allies chose to use Fire Pledge or Water Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Fire Pledge, the ally uses Fire Pledge with 150 power and a sea of fire appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which causes damage to non-Fire types equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn. If combined with Water Pledge, the ally uses Grass Pledge with 150 power and a swamp appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which quarters the Speed of each Pokemon on that side. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Grass Gem.

grasswhistle.name: Grass Whistle
grasswhistle.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.
grasswhistle.fullDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

grassyglide.name: Grassy Glide
grassyglide.fullDesc: If the current terrain is Grassy Terrain and the user is grounded, this move has its priority increased by 1.

grassyterrain.name: Grassy Terrain
grassyterrain.fullDesc: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Grassy Terrain. During the effect, the power of Grass-type attacks used by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3, the power of Bulldoze, Earthquake, and Magnitude used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5, and grounded Pokemon have 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn, including the last turn. Camouflage transforms the user into a Grass type, Nature Power becomes Energy Ball, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause sleep. Fails if the current terrain is Grassy Terrain.

gravapple.name: Grav Apple
gravapple.fullDesc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage. Power is multiplied by 1.5 during Gravity's effect.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.fullDesc: For 5 turns, the evasiveness of all active Pokemon is multiplied by 0.6. At the time of use, Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, and Telekinesis end immediately for all active Pokemon. During the effect, Bounce, Fly, Flying Press, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, Splash, and Telekinesis are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. Ground-type attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability can affect Flying types or Pokemon with the Levitate Ability. Fails if this move is already in effect.

growl.name: Growl
growl.fullDesc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

growth.name: Growth
growth.shortDesc: Raises user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1; 2 in Sun.
growth.fullDesc: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If the weather is Sun or Intense Sun, this move raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella, this move will only raise the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage, even if the weather is Sun or Intense Sun.

grudge.name: Grudge
grudge.shortDesc: If the user faints, the attack used loses all its PP.
grudge.fullDesc: Until the user's next turn, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that move loses all its remaining PP.

guardianofalola.name: Guardian of Alola
guardianofalola.shortDesc: Does damage equal to 3/4 target's current HP.
guardianofalola.fullDesc: Deals damage to the target equal to 3/4 of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

guardsplit.name: Guard Split
guardsplit.shortDesc: Averages Defense and Sp. Def stats with target.
guardsplit.fullDesc: The user and the target have their Defense and Special Defense stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Defense and Special Defense stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

guardswap.name: Guard Swap
guardswap.shortDesc: Swaps Defense and Sp. Def changes with target.
guardswap.fullDesc: The user swaps its Defense and Special Defense stat stage changes with the target.

guillotine.name: Guillotine
guillotine.shortDesc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.
guillotine.fullDesc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

gunkshot.name: Gunk Shot
gunkshot.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

gust.name: Gust
gust.shortDesc: Power doubles during Bounce, Fly, and Sky Drop.
gust.fullDesc: Power doubles if the target is using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.

gyroball.name: Gyro Ball
gyroball.shortDesc: More power the slower the user than the target.
gyroball.fullDesc: Power is equal to (25 * target's current Speed / user's current Speed) + 1, rounded down, but not more than 150. If the user's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 1.

hail.name: Hail
hail.fullDesc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Hail. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are an Ice type or have the Ice Body, Magic Guard, Overcoat, or Snow Cloak Abilities. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Hail.

hammerarm.name: Hammer Arm
hammerarm.fullDesc: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.

harden.name: Harden
harden.fullDesc: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.

hardpress.name: Hard Press
hardpress.shortDesc: More power the more HP the target has left.
hardpress.fullDesc: Power is equal to 100 × (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.

haze.name: Haze
haze.fullDesc: Resets the stat stages of all active Pokemon to 0.

headbutt.name: Headbutt
headbutt.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
headbutt.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

headcharge.name: Head Charge
headcharge.fullDesc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

headlongrush.name: Headlong Rush
headlongrush.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
headlongrush.fullDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

headsmash.name: Head Smash
headsmash.fullDesc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

healbell.name: Heal Bell
healbell.shortDesc: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.
healbell.fullDesc: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Active Pokemon with the Soundproof Ability are not cured, unless they are the user.

healblock.name: Heal Block
healblock.shortDesc: For 5 turns, the foe(s) is prevented from healing.
healblock.fullDesc: For 5 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.

healingwish.name: Healing Wish
healingwish.shortDesc: User faints. Next hurt Pokemon is fully healed.
healingwish.fullDesc: The user faints, and if the Pokemon brought out to replace it does not have full HP or has a non-volatile status condition, its HP is fully restored along with having any non-volatile status condition cured. The replacement is sent out at the end of the turn, and the healing happens before hazards take effect. This effect continues until a Pokemon that meets either of these conditions switches in at the user's position or gets swapped into the position with Ally Switch. Fails if the user is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party.

healorder.name: Heal Order
healorder.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
healorder.fullDesc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

healpulse.name: Heal Pulse
healpulse.shortDesc: Heals the target by 50% of its max HP.
healpulse.fullDesc: The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user has the Mega Launcher Ability, the target instead restores 3/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.

heartstamp.name: Heart Stamp
heartstamp.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
heartstamp.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

heartswap.name: Heart Swap
heartswap.shortDesc: Swaps all stat changes with target.
heartswap.fullDesc: The user swaps all its stat stage changes with the target.

heatcrash.name: Heat Crash
heatcrash.shortDesc: More power the heavier the user than the target.
heatcrash.fullDesc: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

heatwave.name: Heat Wave
heatwave.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

heavyslam.name: Heavy Slam
heavyslam.shortDesc: More power the heavier the user than the target.
heavyslam.fullDesc: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

helpinghand.name: Helping Hand
helpinghand.shortDesc: One adjacent ally's move power is 1.5× this turn.
helpinghand.fullDesc: The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.

hex.name: Hex
hex.shortDesc: Power doubles if the target has a status ailment.
hex.fullDesc: Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.

hiddenpower.name: Hidden Power
hiddenpower.shortDesc: Varies in type based on the user's IVs.
hiddenpower.fullDesc: This move's type depends on the user's individual values (IVs), and can be any type but Fairy and Normal.

highjumpkick.name: High Jump Kick
highjumpkick.shortDesc: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.
highjumpkick.fullDesc: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.

holdback.name: Hold Back
holdback.shortDesc: Always leaves the target with at least 1 HP.
holdback.fullDesc: Leaves the target with at least 1 HP.

holdhands.name: Hold Hands
holdhands.fullDesc: No competitive use. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

honeclaws.name: Hone Claws
honeclaws.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack and accuracy by 1.
honeclaws.fullDesc: Raises the user's Attack and accuracy by 1 stage.

horndrill.name: Horn Drill
horndrill.shortDesc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.
horndrill.fullDesc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

hornleech.name: Horn Leech
hornleech.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
hornleech.fullDesc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

howl.name: Howl
howl.shortDesc: Raises the user's and ally's Attack by 1.
howl.fullDesc: Raises the Attack of the user and all allies 1 stage.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.shortDesc: 30% chance to confuse target. Can't miss in rain.
hurricane.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.

hydrocannon.name: Hydro Cannon
hydrocannon.fullDesc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

hydrosteam.name: Hydro Steam
hydrosteam.shortDesc: During Sun: 1.5× damage instead of half.
hydrosteam.fullDesc: If the current weather is Sun and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella, this move's damage is multiplied by 1.5 instead of halved for being Water type.

hydrovortex.name: Hydro Vortex
hydrovortex.shortDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.
hydrovortex.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

hyperbeam.name: Hyper Beam
hyperbeam.fullDesc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

hyperfang.name: Hyper Fang
hyperfang.shortDesc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.
hyperfang.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

hyperspacefury.name: Hyperspace Fury
hyperspacefury.shortDesc: Hoopa-U: Lowers user's Def by 1; breaks protect.
hyperspacefury.fullDesc: Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Hoopa Unbound. If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.

hyperspacehole.name: Hyperspace Hole
hyperspacehole.shortDesc: Breaks the target's protection for this turn.
hyperspacehole.fullDesc: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.

hypervoice.name: Hyper Voice
hypervoice.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
hypnosis.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.
hypnosis.fullDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

iceball.name: Ice Ball
iceball.shortDesc: Power doubles with each hit. Repeats for 5 turns.
iceball.fullDesc: If this move is successful, the user is locked into this move and cannot make another move until it misses, 5 turns have passed, or the attack cannot be used. Power doubles with each successful hit of this move and doubles again if Defense Curl was used previously by the user. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn.

icebeam.name: Ice Beam
icebeam.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

iceburn.name: Ice Burn
iceburn.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

icefang.name: Ice Fang
icefang.shortDesc: 10% chance to freeze. 10% chance to flinch.
icefang.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.

icehammer.name: Ice Hammer
icehammer.fullDesc: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.

icepunch.name: Ice Punch
icepunch.fullDesc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

icespinner.name: Ice Spinner
icespinner.fullDesc: Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.

iciclecrash.name: Icicle Crash
iciclecrash.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
iciclecrash.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

iciclespear.name: Icicle Spear
iciclespear.fullDesc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

icywind.name: Icy Wind
icywind.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.
icywind.fullDesc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

imprison.name: Imprison
imprison.shortDesc: No foe can use any move known by the user.
imprison.fullDesc: The user prevents all opposing Pokemon from using any moves that the user also knows as long as the user remains active.

incinerate.name: Incinerate
incinerate.fullDesc: The target loses its held item if it is a Berry or a Gem. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

infernalparade.name: Infernal Parade
infernalparade.shortDesc: 30% burn. 2× power if target is already statused.
infernalparade.fullDesc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.fullDesc: Has a 100% chance to burn the target.

infernooverdrive.name: Inferno Overdrive
infernooverdrive.shortDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.
infernooverdrive.fullDesc: Power is equal to the base move's Z-Power.

infestation.name: Infestation
infestation.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
infestation.fullDesc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch.
